$comment: Reactor factories (upstream's Elements/Dsl.cs and friends) with no Isotope factory, for the migration analyzer (#33).
status: winui-only (no Avalonia counterpart in its core) or not-ported (Avalonia has a counterpart; Isotope has no element for it yet).
alternative: what to use instead, shown in the diagnostic. TableAndFixTests fails when Isotope gains one of these factories.
